title: Extraction of Bulk RNA from Mouse Placenta
author: Ramalakshmi Ramasamy
materials: Supplies: Ethanol/RNase Zap Ice/Ice Bucket Tissue samples BeadBug tubes (2 per tissue sample) with 0.5mm high impact zirconium beads Small petri dishes Scalpels Tweezers QIAshredder tubes RNeasy plus mini kit 70% ethanol B-mercaptoethanol Microcentrifuge tubes (2uL) Equipment: BeadBug 6 Benchtop centrifuge Nanodrop
Clean working area and all equipment with 70% ethanol and RNase zap; continue to use RNase zap periodically throughout the protocol

(Step 2 of QIAGEN RNeasy Plus Mini kit) Transfer all flowthrough lysate to gDNA Eliminator spin column placed in a 2mL collection tube a. For mouse placenta, this should correspond to ~250uL of liquid

Continue from here with the QIAGEN RNeasy Plus Mini kit protocol , keeping track of the following notes: a. Step 3–When adding 1 volume of 70% ethanol, add equal amount of lysate used (for mouse placenta, use 250uL of ethanol) b. After Step 7–Do perform the optional spin to dry out column after last wash with Buffer RPE c. Step 8–Use 30uL of RNase free water for final elution step. Add RNase free water directly to the spin column membrane.

steps.title: Thaw Tissue Samples
steps.instruction: Retrieve tissue samples from -80 °C storage and thaw on ice.

steps.title: Prepare BeadBug Tubes
steps.instruction: Fill BeadBug tubes with 600 µL of Buffer RLT Plus.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Buffer RLT Plus by adding β-mercaptoethanol to RLT buffer (10 µl β-ME per 1 ml Buffer RLT)

steps.title: Prepare Placenta Tissue
steps.instruction: Remove placenta from tube using clean tweezers and place into a small petri dish.

substeps.instruction: Cut tissue into small pieces using tweezers and a small scalpel (for mouse placenta, cut into quarters)
Cut different tissue samples in separate areas of the petri dish
Clean tweezers and scalpel between different tissue samples

steps.title: Load Tissue into Tubes
steps.instruction: Use tweezers to place cut tissue pieces into BeadBug tubes containing 600 µL RLT buffer.

substeps.instruction: For mouse placenta, place 2/4 of the tissue in each tube

steps.title: Homogenize Tissue
steps.instruction: Run BeadBug 6 on Cycle 2, Speed 3000, for 90 seconds.

substeps.instruction: Stop after the first 90 seconds; additional time is only needed if tissue is not well homogenized
Run one additional BeadBug cycle if necessary
Spin tubes down in a small centrifuge to remove foam and clear the view

steps.title: Process Lysate for Shredding
steps.instruction: Transfer an appropriate aliquot of homogenized lysate to a QIAshredder tube.

substeps.instruction: For mouse placenta, transfer 1/4 of the total lysate volume (approximately 250 µL)

steps.title: Combine and Store Lysate
steps.instruction: Transfer liquid and as much foam as possible from the 2 BeadBug tubes for each tissue sample into a single 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Spin down during transfer to create space in the tube
Avoid transferring beads or tissue chunks

Optional: Store homogenized lysate at -80 °C. If storing, separate the amount needed for subsequent steps (for mouse placenta, ~250 µL or 1/4 total volume) to avoid unnecessary freeze-thawing of the entire lysate

steps.title: Filter Lysate
steps.instruction: Spin QIAshredder tubes in a centrifuge at 8000g for 30 seconds, or until the liquid flows through the QIAshredder.

steps.title: Quantify RNA
steps.instruction: Measure the RNA concentration using a Nanodrop.

steps.title: Store RNA
steps.instruction: Store RNA at -80 °C until submission for Bulk RNA sequencing.
